info.name: Get the WordPress REST route index

params.name: context
params.description: Scope under which the request is made; determines fields present in the response. Only `view` and `embed` are available anonymously — `edit` returns HTTP 401.

params.name: namespace
params.description: Limit the index to a single namespace, e.g. `wp/v2`.

params.name: _fields
params.description: Comma-separated list of fields to limit the response to. Verified live, e.g. `_fields=id,slug,link,title`.

items.docs: Returns the self-describing API index for cresilon.com — site name, description, URL, timezone offset, the full list of registered namespaces and every route with its methods, args and endpoint metadata. Verified live 2026-08-04: 45 namespaces and 1,021 routes; `authentication` advertises WordPress Application Passwords with the authorization endpoint at https://cresilon.com/wp-admin/authorize-application.php.
